title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.1.1
summary: Version 1.1.1 brings smoother computer arrangement and stronger file-transfer recovery. Promotes the tested RC3 application code unchanged.
changes: Smooth, double-buffered computer matrix with immediate dragging, one/two rows, keyboard arrangement and reliable drag cancellation.
Readable monitor tiles and status labels at enlarged display sizes, retaining native name editors and checkboxes.
Pause transfers visibly when recovery information cannot be saved; resume explicitly after storage is available.
Recover missing or damaged transfer journals from backup, and retain compact completion receipts to handle lost acknowledgements.
Retry temporarily unreadable regular files safely, verify receiving-folder identity, and budget disk space against active transfers.
Reuse receive buffers and reduce redundant recovery writes while retaining checksums and durable completion checkpoints.
testing: RC3 passed 155 automated Windows tests with one existing skip; the owner reports that RC3 is working well on real PCs.
The stable release repeats Windows Release x64 build, automated tests, executable-version and single-file package checks before publication.
Use 1.1.1 on every PC. Finish or cancel transfers, replace the EXE while keeping adjacent preferences and recovery files, or update through Install for me.
known_limitations: One self-contained, unsigned Windows x64 EXE; no Windows service or protected-desktop support.
Full-speed copies can still compete with mouse sharing on busy Wi-Fi.
Folder copies can partially complete. Unsupported links and unreadable directories require a fresh drag.
Recovery records now include compact receipts; keep backups and avoid downgrading while transfers are unfinished.
